briefing: - 今日仅1条高危SQL注入，CVSS 9.1，需优先处置。
- 该漏洞暂无KEV标记、无公开PoC，未见在野利用证据。
- 未见关联勒索软件活动，暂不按勒索事件响应。
- 批量公告趋势不明显，今日为单条漏洞披露。
- 建议立即排查受影响入口并修复，防止后续利用。

items.title: YesWiki 搜索SQL注入可读哈希
items.title_zh: YesWiki 搜索SQL注入可读哈希
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者可在搜索请求中注入反引号构造子查询，读取密码哈希或耗尽数据库线程。
items.action_zh: 升级至4.7.0或5.0.0-alpha4；无法升级时限制搜索接口访问
items.repro_note: 未授权搜索请求参数注入反引号构造子查询验证
items.impact_scope: 自建Wiki/CMS，数据库数据暴露风险
items.description: YesWiki 4.6.0 before 4.7.0 and 5.0.0-alpha1 before 5.0.0-alpha4 contains an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in SearchManager::prepareSearchRequest(). Field names from the query and searchfields parameters of the public Bazar entries search API are placed in a backtick-quoted alias escaped only with mysqli_real_escape_string. Attackers can supply a backtick to inject subqueries, reading data such as user password hashes or exhausting database threads with SLEEP().
